performance-loop-protocol.workload: 24 distinct starting-order fixtures captured from historical production-shuffle games, first 12 screening and second 12 independent confirmation; four pre/post-side games each. Engine RNG remains production behavior; no fixed engine seeds. Differences in actual work retained and reported.
performance-loop-protocol.sampling: 12 paired one-match runs per arm (48 games each); random balanced AB/BA order per fixture; all samples retained. Independent second 12-pair confirmation required before any retain.
performance-loop-protocol.test: Exact paired one-sided sign-flip permutation test on run-mean differences, 4096 permutations. Retain only when both screening and independent confirmation p <= 0.005 and candidate average lower in both. This accounts for run clustering and fixture workload; two-stage gate reduces chance findings across many attempts. No optional early termination of samples.
performance-loop-protocol.scope: Full mandatory game evidence/hash/XML/schema/fsync/progress. Sequential real-core games. No soak. Same isolated worktree, power configuration and filesystem. Frozen engine untouched.
performance-loop-protocol.profile: Use existing per-game engine/setup/projection/IPC/hash/XML/validation/filesystem timers before selecting each candidate; record observed phase means in every iteration.
performance-loop-protocol.historical: Prior artifacts/aro2-performance-loop preserved unchanged. Initial streak 10. Statistically supported retained improvement resets to zero. Aspirational 50ms does not stop the loop.
